pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Venti holds a Christmas present beside a decorated tree, wearing mittens and a Santa hat with holly leaves. pages.title: Chibi Spider-Man in a Santa Hat with a Gift Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Spider-Man wears a Santa hat in this printable coloring page, holding a large wrapped present while extending his other hand in a web-shooting pose. pages.title: Lisa Simpson in a Santa Coat and Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: Lisa Simpson wears a Santa coat and boots in this printable coloring page, with a wide belt, round earring, and festive garland across her hair. A bow and round baubles decorate the garland, while fluffy trim follows the coat front, cuffs, and boot tops. The plain background keeps attention on Lisa's complete standing figure.

pages.title: New Year Champagne Glasses Coloring Page
pages.description: Two champagne glasses touch at their rims in this printable coloring page, with round bubbles rising above the stems and curled ribbons nearby. The matching glass shapes balance the composition on either side.

pages.description: A feathered masquerade mask spans this printable coloring page, with pointed eye openings, a central star, and a slender handle on one side. Curved bands and sweeping feather edges divide the mask into separate sections.

pages.title: New Year Cupcake Coloring Page
pages.description: A sparkler tops the swirl of frosting in this printable coloring page, above a cupcake decorated with stars and round sprinkles. Vertical wrapper folds contrast with the curved layers of icing.

pages.title: New Year Cake Coloring Page
pages.description: A two-tier New Year cake fills this printable coloring page, with a clock topper, star decorations, and scalloped frosting on both tiers. A pedestal stand supports the cake beneath a row of rounded icing beads.

pages.title: New Year Cookies Coloring Page
pages.description: A clock, a party hat, and a star appear as decorated cookies in this printable coloring page, arranged on a round plate. Double icing outlines separate the designs from their baked edges.

pages.title: January 1 Calendar Coloring Page
pages.description: A January 1 calendar fills this printable coloring page, with a large outlined numeral beneath the month and two rings at the top. Stars and short accent marks decorate the date panel.

pages.title: New Year Resolutions Coloring Page
pages.description: A child writes New Year resolutions in this printable coloring page, with an open notebook, a pencil, and an alarm clock on the desk. Fireworks appear through the window behind the seated figure.

pages.description: An upright hourglass fills this printable coloring page, with rounded pillars, outlined sand grains, and stars around its wooden-style frame. The narrow center separates the two chambers and the falling grains.

pages.title: New Year Family Celebration Coloring Page

pages.description: A folded New Year greeting card stands upright in this printable coloring page, with a midnight clock, three firework bursts, and ribbons on its cover. The back panel peeks above the front edge.

pages.title: New Year Big Ben Coloring Page

pages.title: New Year Teddy Bear Coloring Page
pages.description: A teddy bear holds a star-shaped balloon in this printable coloring page, with stitched seams on its belly and paws beneath a party hat. The balloon string curves past its raised paw.

pages.title: New Year Dog Coloring Page
pages.description: A dog sits beneath a pointed party hat in this printable coloring page, with floppy ears, a wagging tail, and a wide streamer across its chest. The ribbon trails along the floor beside its paws.

pages.title: New Year Unicorn Coloring Page
pages.description: A unicorn stands beside a midnight clock in this printable coloring page, with a striped horn, flowing mane, and spotted party hat. Small fireworks sit above the head and the four hooves are visible below.

pages.title: Hello Kitty New Year Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Kitty holds a star balloon in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped party hat, her familiar ear bow, and a scalloped dress. A waist bow and streamers fill smaller areas around the figure.

pages.description: Snoopy lifts one foot as he blows a party horn in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped hat beneath two firework bursts. His raised paws meet near the front of his chest.
